name: Melee
description: Fights up close, at the front of the line -- the first ones enemies reach and the last ones a formation can afford to lose.

name: Ranged
description: Strikes from a distance, hitting what melee can't close on in time -- flyers, casters hiding in the back, anything that punishes getting close.

name: Caster
description: Channels arcane or divine power -- the answer to threats that shrug off plain steel, the undead chief among them.
